scope: Independent real qualification() API control using an explicitly synthetic 60-task/180-row register; not a model run
fix: Executed Pass/Fail rows sharing a profile must match source_commit, runner_image, provider_route, model_version, browser_os, app_digest, knowledge_digest and budgets_digest. Different named profiles remain independent; per-attempt usage/duration and unexecuted empty metadata stay valid.
limitations: Identity consistency is not evidence-byte authenticity, oracle correctness, fixed upstream identity, DPA, operational qualification or a full G8 pass. Unknown but consistent model_version still permits only explicitly route-level evidence.
